entries.description: Minimal Terraform configuration for a local Docker-based workload. Requires Terraform >= 1.5.0. Uses kreuzwerker/docker provider ~> 3.0. Accepts build_context string variable. Outputs a container_name placeholder.
decision_rules: Use for local development and testing environments managed via Terraform + Docker
Pin kreuzwerker/docker provider to ~> 3.0 for compatibility and stability
tradeoffs: Local state only — not suitable for team collaboration without a remote backend (S3 + DynamoDB)
Docker provider may not be available in all CI environments
anti_patterns: Do not use this pattern for production workloads — use AWS ECS, EKS, or equivalent
Do not omit required_version — version constraints prevent accidental upgrades
